cases.purpose: Check mode-000 open failure, /dev/null fsync EINVAL and injected middle-operand EIO. Diagnostics use GNU wording: error opening and error syncing. Aggregate status, fd lifetime and continuation stay in the contract.
cases.oracle: Bash sync loadable contract and seccomp notification log; fixed C locale and unprivileged uid 2000
cases.comparison: Exact contract output; each failure must name only the failing operand. The EIO injection observes three fsync calls and checks the fd table after the failure.

files.inner.sh:
fds() { local f; FDS=; for f in /proc/self/fd/*; do FDS+=" ${f##*/}"; done; }
fds; before=$FDS
sync first middle last 2>eio.err
rc=$?
fds
printf 'eio-status=%s fd-table=' "$rc"
[[ $FDS == "$before" ]] && printf 'unchanged\n' || printf 'changed\n'

cases.script:
export LC_ALL=C PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
[[ $EUID == 2000 ]] && echo uid=2000 || echo uid=WRONG
sync first denied last 2>open.err
rc=$?
printf 'open-status=%s\n' "$rc"
mapfile -t lines <open.err
[[ ${#lines[@]} == 1 && ${lines[0]} == *denied* && ${lines[0]} == *'error opening'* && ${lines[0]} == *'Permission denied'* ]] && echo open-diagnostic=ok || echo open-diagnostic=BAD
sync first /dev/null last 2>null.err
rc=$?
printf 'null-status=%s\n' "$rc"
mapfile -t lines <null.err
[[ ${#lines[@]} == 1 && ${lines[0]} == *'/dev/null'* && ${lines[0]} == *'error syncing'* && ${lines[0]} == *'Invalid argument'* ]] && echo null-diagnostic=ok || echo null-diagnostic=BAD
: >"$HOME/eio.jsonl"
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py --notify fsync --reply-seq fsync=continue,EIO,continue --log "$HOME/eio.jsonl" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc inner.sh
printf 'helper-status=%s\n' "$?"
mapfile -t lines <eio.err
[[ ${#lines[@]} == 1 && ${lines[0]} == *middle* && ${lines[0]} == *'error syncing'* && ${lines[0]} == *'Input/output error'* ]] && echo eio-diagnostic=ok || echo eio-diagnostic=BAD
calls=0 injected=0
while IFS= read -r line; do
  [[ $line == *'"syscall": "fsync"'* ]] || continue
  ((calls++))
  [[ $line == *'"reply": "continue"'* ]] || ((injected++))
done <"$HOME/eio.jsonl"
printf 'fsync-calls=%d injected=%d\n' "$calls" "$injected"
cases.stdout:
uid=2000
open-status=1
open-diagnostic=ok
null-status=1
null-diagnostic=ok
eio-status=1 fd-table=unchanged
helper-status=0
eio-diagnostic=ok
fsync-calls=3 injected=1
